description: In every PA-model, if \(p\) is coprime to both \(q\) and \(r\), then \(p\) is coprime to \(qr\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.coprime_product_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (p q r : M)
  (hpq : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M p q)
  (hpr : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M p r) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M p
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M q r)
